svg.title: OL-DOUBT cohort plates: painted scenery that physically tears
svg.desc: Four painted plates in the Stitches-in-the-Canvas craft. Plate 1: a gilt night star-map tearing open over broadsheet columns. Plate 2: a curiosity cabinet of tilted specimen frames over a torn wall-chart. Plate 3: the white Jacobite cockade over Stuart-rose wallpaper with a torn corner. Plate 4: a torn Putney Debates broadsheet nailed to a dark board.
